name: Sounds Around You
description: A one-minute pause for listening to the sounds near and far.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A short listening pause of near, far and quiet sounds, on Guided Pause.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Use as many steps as you like.
howToPlay: Press Begin when you are ready.
Listen to what each step suggests. It moves on by itself.
Press Next to skip a step or Back to repeat one.
tips: Quiet rooms still have sounds, such as a fan or your own clothes moving. Skip any step that does not suit you.
